item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"RSF reported that physical attacks against journalists occurred during the 8 January 2023 riots and that Brazil lacked a robust policy for protecting journalists despite constitutional protection for press freedom.","notes":["The excerpt says attacks on the press were frequent on social media and that repeated physical attacks occurred during the riots; it does not directly say attacks during the riots were frequent."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E013","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Brazil’s federal government resumed the Minha Casa, Minha Vida programme in 2023 and reported completing and delivering more than 21,000 previously stalled or slow-moving homes, benefiting about 80,000 people; more than 490,000 homes were contracted in 2023, including over 185,000 for families earning up to R$2,640 per month.","notes":["The excerpt attributes the resumption to Novo PAC and identifies the federal government for some measures, but does not explicitly say the Lula government relaunched the programme."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E014","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The housing programme reported more than R$8.9 billion in FGTS subsidies; about 317,000 families had payments reduced from 120 to 60 installments, and the federal government paid off homes for more than 388,000 Bolsa Família or BPC beneficiary families. The excerpt explicitly dates the more than 490,000 housing contracts to 2023, but not each of these other measures.","notes":["The summary applied the 2023 date to all measures, while the excerpt explicitly dates only the housing contracts to 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E016","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"UNESCO identified significant disparities in educational quality between public and private institutions and across Brazilian regions, deficient learning performance, and low absorption of scientific concepts; UNESCO supported capacity-building, planning, indicators, policy studies, and innovative education programmes in Brazil.","notes":["The excerpt supports significant disparities but does not explicitly establish that they are persistent or major."]}]}
